pullRequests.head: aut-39-code-2pct
pullRequests.body:
Hey @Lynder063 great work so far on the ratchet and clank games. I want to contribute my work as well. It is obviously AI assisted, but hey I would rather spend more time by myself modding the 100% decomp than spending 5+years to reach 100%.
If you have any suggestions how to improve my contributions please say so.
Summary
Raises matched code from 0.513% to 1.332% (26,572 → 68,920 of 5,175,440 bytes) and matched functions from 243 to 808 (1.6% → 5.4%). It also fixes two build tools that were…
